subject: Security exhibit redlines + evidence cadence — next steps
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@vinehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@vinehealth.com, SecurityOps Team <secops@vinehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft security exhibit + SOC 2 attestation request

Alex —

Thanks for sending a preview of the order form. Before we finalize procurement, a couple asks from our side on the security exhibit and audit language:

- We require a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12-month period) and an accompanying control map that maps Redwood controls to SOC 2 criteria.
- Pen-test language: VineHealth needs an explicit window for on-demand pen tests with a 30-day courtesy notice for production scope; test plan to be shared in advance.
- Audit rights: our legal team prefers limited inspection only (no tenant-wide privileged access) and a designated evidence cadence (we typically ask for an evidence packet every quarter and ad-hoc logs for incidents).
- Evidence cadence: we want a proposed matrix of artifacts and owner contacts (for SOC artifacts, system diagrams, and sampling sets).

I'm attaching our standard security questionnaire — it has some overlapping asks. Can you propose redlines to the MSA/order form and confirm whether Redwood can provide KMS/HSM details and VPC deployment assurances?

Would like to schedule a 30-minute call this week with legal + security to align.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Vendor Risk
VineHealth

Attachments: VineHealth_Security_Questionnaire.pdf
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@vinehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft security exhibit + SOC 2 attestation request

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick plan from our side:

1) I'll attach a redlined MSA focused on the security exhibit and order form language (see attached redlined_MSA_v2.docx).
2) Laura (legal) will review the audit-rights and limited inspection wording — we typically trade limited inspection + scoped sampling for SOC 2 evidence and a documented pen-test process.
3) Ben (AE) will coordinate procurement timing and the DocuSign flow.
4) Proposed evidence cadence: quarterly evidence packet (SOC 2, control matrix, system diagrams), ad-hoc incident logs within 5 business days for classified incidents, and an agreed pen-test notice window (we typically ask for 14 days).

We can be flexible on the pen-test notice window — I expect legal will push back on the 30-day ask as operationally constraining. On KMS/HSM and VPC: Redwood Dedicated and Private both support customer-managed KMS integrations; we can provide architecture diagrams and a short KMS/HSM integration note.

Proposed times for a 30-minute sync: Tue 5/20 10:00am PT or Wed 5/21 1:30pm PT. Which works for you?

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlined_MSA_v2.docx

Folks —

I reviewed the attached redline and compiled a short legal note. High-level positions below (detailed redline inline in redlined_MSA_v2.docx):

- SOC 2: we can provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a SOC control mapping. We will provide a compressed evidence package on a quarterly cadence; we cannot commit to continuous privileged access.
- Pen-test: Redwood accepts customer-requested pen-tests on a scoped, mutually-agreed basis. Our standard internal ask is a 14-day operational notice (to ensure scheduling and guardrails). If customer needs 30 days, recommend we accept a 30-day notice for production-only scoped tests but limit scope to agreed systems. We'll add language requiring customer to provide test plan and non-production options where required.
- Audit rights / inspection: propose 'limited inspection' clause: vendor shall provide evidence, sample sets, and a read-only review environment for inspections. We will not allow direct tenant-wide privileged access nor host credential disclosure.
- Evidence cadence: propose a one-page evidence matrix (owner, artifact, delivery cadence, redaction rules). See attached evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx; Laura (Legal) will be the Redwood owner for SOC artifacts, and Security Engineering will own pen-test coordination.

Open items that need negotiation with the customer: indemnity/coverage around findings from customer-initiated pen-tests, and whether we will permit any remote forensic access for incident-related sampling — I recommend limited comms (logs and filtered exports) instead.

I will send a tracked redline and a short summary of the legal positions before the call.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Transactions & Security
Redwood Inference

Thanks Alex + Laura —

A few clarifications from our SecurityOps / procurement side after reviewing your positions:

- The 30-day notice is not negotiable for production pen-tests at our compliance program (our board requires longer window). If Redwood can accept 30 days for prod scope, we can accept your limited inspection approach.
- On evidence cadence: quarterly compressed package is fine. For incidents, we need the ability to request logs and relevant exports within 7 business days for high-severity incidents (Severity 1/2).
- On indemnity: we will not require additional indemnity for customer-conducted pen-tests as long as the test plan is approved in advance and scope is limited; we need language that the customer will not exploit findings for extortion or operational disruption.

Procurement also asked for a DocuSign path and an estimated signature timeline — we typically need contract fully executed within 2 weeks after final redline.

Available to meet Tue 5/20 10:00am PT.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Vendor Risk
VineHealth

Elena / team — thanks for the call earlier. Quick summary and agreed actions so procurement/legal have a single thread to track:

Agreements reached
- Redwood will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a control mapping within the quarterly evidence packet.
- Pen-test notice: Redwood accepts a 30-day notice requirement for production-scoped customer-initiated pen-tests, provided the scope is mutually agreed and a test plan is shared 10 business days before the window.
- Audit rights: accepted limited inspection language; Redwood will provide artifact packages, sample sets, and a read-only review arrangement for scoped inspections; no privileged tenant-wide access.
- Incident data: Redwood will provide requested logs/exports for Sev1/2 incidents within 5 business days (we agreed to 5 to balance investigation and operational filtering).

Action items
- Alex: publish final tracked redline (MSA + security exhibit) and upload to DocuSign for signature routing (target: 2-week signature window). Attachment: redlined_MSA_v2.docx (to be updated with final legal comments).
- Laura: finalize indemnity/pen-test carve language and confirm telemetry redaction rules (ETA: 2 business days).
- Ben: confirm commercial cadence and send DocuSign routing once redline is finalized.
- Elena / VineHealth: confirm procurement path and provide contact for signature ops (procurement@vinehealth.com).

Attachments included: redlined_MSA_v2.docx (tracked), evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx, VineHealth_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

If no objections, I'll push the updated redline by end of day tomorrow.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
